# Message passing dependability work

Use [rules-score-update](../skills/rules-score-update/SKILL.md) for
`score/message_passing/`. Start with its
[knowledge index](../../score/message_passing/maintenance/README.md) and the
[repository depot](../../docs/engineering/seooc-maintenance.md). Read topic notes,
external tooling context, and the selected feature's current cycle only as relevant.

Existing dependability artifacts are the starting baseline, not a disposable PoC.
Keep review/research requests read-only for product artifacts unless fixes are
requested. Do not resume paused safety work or create a new cycle merely because
a backlog exists. With no concrete request, provide orientation and stop.

For substantive authorized work, reuse or create the applicable semantic feature
under `score/message_passing/work/` and use bounded human-gated cycles.
Do not regenerate a requirement inventory or bootstrap the legacy `research/`
scratchpad. Legacy research and copied memory are historical evidence to consult
only for a specific question.
